$ labctl app list
Applications:
  demo-app             build=         deploy=       port=8080   capabilities=none
  go-api               build=         deploy=       port=8080   capabilities=none

$ labctl app capabilities
Workload capabilities:
  otlp-tracing         honours OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT and exports spans
  prometheus-metrics   serves the metrics path in Prometheus format, including the request-duration histogram
  readiness-toggle     readiness can be flipped to failing on demand

$ labctl app verify demo-app --static
Contract for demo-app
  port:           8080
  health:         /health
  ready:          /ready
  namespace:      demo-app
  capabilities:   none

✓ declaration is valid

$ labctl app build demo-app
Building demo-app...
build demo-app

$ labctl app deploy demo-app
Deploying demo-app...
deploy deploy demo-app

$ labctl app destroy demo-app
Destroying demo-app...
deploy destroy demo-app
